svg.title: The Pipeline makes leakage impossible, not merely discouraged
svg.desc: A wrong workflow at the top where a scaler and selector are fitted on all data before the five cross-validation folds, crossed out in red and annotated 0.815 accuracy on pure noise, above a correct workflow where each fold carries its own fit step and scores 0.510, with the 30.5-point gap circled between them, and the Pipeline object drawn on the right as a ColumnTransformer feeding a LogisticRegression under a single fit arrow.
svg.text: The Pipeline makes leakage impossible, not merely discouraged
